## Goal

Build the customer-facing subscription flows on top of the existing `BillingPort`.

## Context

`/predplatne` is an explicit stub. The port supports checkout sessions, plan change, cancel, payment-method update, refunds.

## Scope

- Price selection, Stripe Payment Element confirmation, success and failure pages.
- Account: cancel at period end (two clicks max), revoke cancellation, change plan, update card, invoices list exists already.
- Design rules 79 to 92.

## Out of scope

- Live keys.
- Coupons, trials, gifting.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All flows work in Stripe test mode, recorded in SC-010.
- [ ] Cancellation confirms end date and access stays until then.
- [ ] Codex review approves.

## Required tests

- Unit tests for any new server actions.
- Playwright test-mode checkout once SC-011 is in.

## Dependencies

- SC-008

## Priority

P1 · Phase B

## Agent

Claude Code
